applicant.organisation: AUVA (public accident insurance), occupational health prevention

purpose: We plan workplace health promotion for employees with metabolic disease and need regional prevalence to target our occupational physicians' prevention visits.
question: How many adults have type 2 diabetes, per region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes.
